def find_centroid(n, tree, size):
    def dfs(node, parent):
        nonlocal centroid
        size[node] = 1
        max_subtree = 0
        for child in tree[node]:
            if child != parent:
                dfs(child, node)
                size[node] += size[child]
                max_subtree = max(max_subtree, size[child])
        max_subtree = max(max_subtree, n - size[node])
        if max_subtree <= n // 2:

    dfs(1, -1)
